function.name: update_user_profile
function.description: Updates the user profile with the provided details. If certain details are not provided, existing information is retained. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

email.description: The updated email address for the user.

phone.description: The updated phone number for the user in E.164 format, such as '+1234567890'.

preferences.description: The updated preferences for the user. If not provided, the default preferences will be used.

newsletter_subscribed.description: Indicates if the user is subscribed to the newsletter.

birthdate.description: The updated birthdate of the user in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

message.content:

“Explain quantum tunneling.” | | **Generate text** – essays, stories, poems, emails, reports, code snippets | “Write a short story about time travel.”
“Help me draft an apology letter.” | | **Summarize or explain complex material** – research papers, news articles, legal documents | “Give me a concise summary of this article.” | | **Assist with learning** – practice problems, study guides, tutoring on specific topics | “Show me step‑by‑step solutions to quadratic equations.” | | **Creative brainstorming** – ideas for projects, names, marketing slogans | “Brainstorm five catchy taglines for a vegan bakery.” | | **Technical support** – debugging tips, algorithm design, best practices | “Why does my loop run forever?” | | **Planning & organization** – schedules, itineraries, checklists | “Plan a two‑week trip to Japan.” | | **Language assistance** – translations (informal), grammar checks, style suggestions | “Translate ‘Good morning’ into Spanish.” | …and much more—just let me know what you’re looking for! How can I assist you today?

User asks general question about capabilities. We should respond politely and mention we can help with many tasks like answering questions, providing explanations, generating content, etc. Also ask how they want us to assist.
